speaker: Kael
text: There you are. You hold that sword like it owes you money, you know.

speaker: Kai
text: It was a hunting knife until two months ago. Old habits.

speaker: Kael
text: Ha! Fair. Come on — the dummies are free, and I need a partner who doesn't fight like the drill manual.

speaker: Kai
text: ...You're asking me to spar. With you.

speaker: Kael
text: No, I'm asking the other mushroom forager with a sword. Yes, you.

speaker: Kai
text: Most people here wait to see if I explode first.

speaker: Kael
text: Waiting's boring. Besides, if you do explode, I want front-row seats. En garde, Oakstead.

speaker: Kai
text: He didn't flinch. He didn't even pause. ...Fine. But I'm not going easy on you.

speaker: Kael
text: Wouldn't forgive you if you did.
